Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer drop-shipping?

We offer approved dealers dropshipping rates.

I don't see my dealer discount reflected when browsing your site. Why am I getting regular list prices?

For approved dealers, discounts are reflected on the site as soon as you sign in to your account. For comparison, please log out of your account and re-check the price of a particular product. If you see the same prices when signed in or out of your dealer account, please contact your account manager for assistance.

What are the cost of the products from your various solutions?

To receive detailed pricing information on our diverse range of products and solutions, we invite you to become a Renogy partner. As a partner, you’ll gain access to our exclusive partner portal, where comprehensive pricing details are available. To get started, please contact our sales team or register directly to become a partner.

Do you have any marketing materials for our shop or website?

Depending on the material, our team may have pre-made literature and graphics for you to use. Custom work and assistance is dependent on the request.
